Sends what you wrote to the stream as one message to an address given as text, and empties the stream for the next one. It does what [SendUDPMsg](SendUDPMsg) does, but the address can be IPv6 and can be a host name.

```blitzbasic
;run
a = CreateUDPStream(40762)
b = CreateUDPStream(40763)
UDPTimeouts 1000
WriteInt a, 12345
SendUDPMsgTo a, "127.0.0.1", 40763
Print RecvUDPMsg(b)
Print ReadInt(b)
CloseUDPStream a
CloseUDPStream b
```

```text
4
12345
```
@param udp_stream  The stream to send from.
@param address     The receiver's address or host name, as text. Brackets around an IPv6 address are allowed.
@param dest_port   The receiver's port. Defaults to 0, which means the port of this stream.
@gap Not in the original. The message is dropped if the address can not be found, or is an IPv6 address on a system without IPv6. See [IPv6](IPv6).
